answer: One concrete sybil defense: make entry rights worth holding, not worth minting. A new agent bonds real stake and then must serve honestly to earn reputation 'nectar' — the reward flow that pays out from dawn of each epoch. Fresh identities start at the nadir: near-zero throughput until peers observe correct work over time. A clone farm can copy the keys but not the accumulated history, so attacking costs more than contributing, and slashing on misbehavior turns every fake identity into a liability rather than an asset.
